sentences.text: Petitioner in these cases are one and the same.
He was a Cricket Coach in Kerala Cricket Association.
The allegation against the petitioner is that he committed rape on his own students.
Almost all these cases are registered under Section 376 of IPC.
The petitioner is in custody from 12.06.2024 onwards.
2. When these cases came up for consideration, and after hearing the counsel for the petitioner and the Public Prosecutor, this Court was not inclined to grant bail.
Hence, this Court directed the Registry to get a report about the time required to dispose the cases.

The Additional District &
Sessions Court, Thiruvananthapuram, submitted a report stating that the Forensic Science Laboratory report is not 2024:KER:94081 BAIL APPL. NO.8632 OF 2024 & connected cases received and on the receipt of the same, these cases can be disposed within five months.
3. Recording the above submission, these bail applications can be disposed of.

Therefore, these bail applications are disposed of directing the Jurisdictional Court to dispose the cases within five months from the date of the receipt of the copy of Forensic Science Laboratory Report.

Sd/-
